visual_action: Donald Trump speaks directly to the camera while seated at a desk, likely in the Oval Office, with American flags visible behind him. The video is a single, static shot. The clip concludes with a white line drawing of the White House and text appearing on a black screen.

cast.name: Donald J. Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown and speaks throughout the video, identifying himself by name: "your favorite president, Donald J. Trump."

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Trump mentions him by name, referring to him as "sleepy Joe Biden."

spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces the launch of a new official White House app, which he says will give users "front row access" to news from "your favorite president, Donald J. Trump." He states the app allows people to watch White House events, read executive orders, and track his fulfillment of his campaign slogan, "promises made, promises kept." Trump claims his administration is the "most transparent in history," contrasting it with his predecessor, "sleepy Joe Biden," whom he says no one knew what he was doing. He concludes by inviting Americans to join the mission to "Make America Great Again" and to download the app.
central_claim: The Trump administration is the most transparent in history, and supporters should download the new official White House app to stay informed about its successes.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers to download the White House app, reinforce their support for Trump, and feel pride in his administration's accomplishments and transparency.
